morning_judgment: August 25 strengthens the carrier-capacity baseline: U.S. pressure on China and Iran is being calibrated through trade and sanctions carriers; Russia is pushing infrastructure defense costs onto private owners after Ukrainian drone strikes; Canada is answering U.S. tariffs with targeted retaliation and business support; and Syria-Israel talks keep regional security inside a mediated architecture rather than a clean bilateral file.
